name: Gray code, low mutation
lesson: In Gray code, neighbouring numbers differ by one bit, so the same low mutation rate keeps climbing the hill.
lookFor: The same seed, landscape and settings as the plain binary preset, with Gray code. Run until stop pauses at generation 39, within ε of the optimum at (2, −1). With seeds 1 to 100, all 100 Gray-coded runs reach ε against 33 plain-binary ones.
